id.description: A unique ID for the Load Balancer.

date_created.description: Date this Load Balancer was created.

region.description: The [Region id](#operation/list-regions) where the Load Balancer is located.

label.description: The user-supplied label for this load-balancer.

ipv4.description: The IPv4 address of this Load Balancer.

ipv6.description: The IPv6 address of this Load Balancer.

ssl_redirect.description:
If `true`, this will redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS. You must have an HTTPS rule and SSL certificate installed on the load balancer to enable this option.

* true
* false

cookie_name.description: The cookie name to make sticky. See [Load Balancer documentation](https://www.vultr.com/docs/vultr-load-balancers#Load_Balancer_Configuration).

proxy_protocol.description:
"If `true`, you must configure backend nodes to accept Proxy protocol. 

* true
* false (Default)"

private_network.description: ID of the private network you wish to use. If private_network is omitted it will default to the public network.

health_check.description: The health check object configuration. See [Load Balancer documentation](https://www.vultr.com/docs/vultr-load-balancers#Load_Balancer_Configuration).

protocol.description:
The protocol to use for health checks.

* HTTPS
* HTTP
* TCP

port.description: The port to use for health checks.

path.description: HTTP Path to check. Only applies if Protocol is HTTP or HTTPS.

unhealthy_threshold.description: Number times a check must fail before becoming unhealthy.

healthy_threshold.description: Number of times a check must succeed before returning to healthy status.

has_ssl.description: Indicates if this Load Balancer has an SSL certificate installed.

forward_rules.description: An array of forwarding rule objects.

id.description: A unique ID for the forwarding rule.

frontend_protocol.description:
The protocol on the Load Balancer to forward to the backend.

* HTTP
* HTTPS
* TCP

frontend_port.description: The port number on the Load Balancer to forward to the backend.

backend_portocol.description:
The protocol destination on the backend server.

* HTTP
* HTTPS
* TCP

backend_port.description: The port number destination on the backend server.

instances.description: Array of [Instance ids](#operation/list-instances) attached to this Load Balancer.

firewall_rules.description: An array of firewall rule objects.

id.description: A unique ID for the firewall rule.

source.description:
If the source string is given a value of "cloudflare" then cloudflare IPs will be supplied. Otherwise enter a IP address with subnet size that you wish to permit through the firewall.

  Possible values:

  |   | Value | Description |
  | - | ------ | ------------- |
  |   | "192.168.1.1/16" | Ip address with a subnet size. |
  |   | cloudflare | Allow all of Cloudflare's IP space through the firewall |

ip_type.description:
The type of IP rule.

* v4
* v6
